_comment: Production catalog referencing the published GHCR images (ghcr.io/medmcp). Baked into the core image at /app/catalog.ghcr.json; point MEDMCP_CATALOG_URL at it on deployments that pull from GHCR. Pin :main to a specific :<sha> for reproducible fleets.

stacks.name: medmcp-dicom
stacks.description: DICOM discovery, NIfTI conversion, and BIDS organisation.

stacks.name: medmcp-neuro-core
stacks.description: Brain extraction (HD-BET), image registration (ANTs), and whole-brain segmentation (FastSurfer).

stacks.name: medmcp-neuro-ms
stacks.description: MS white-matter lesion segmentation and lesion load (LST-AI).

stacks.name: medmcp-totalsegmentator
stacks.description: Whole-body anatomy segmentation on CT and MR, plus focused models for the spine, lungs, liver, head and neck, and teeth (TotalSegmentator).

stacks.name: medmcp-cardiac
stacks.description: Cardiac MRI and CT: ventricle segmentation on short- and long-axis cines (CineMA), ejection fraction, volumes, LV mass and cardiac output, AHA 16-segment wall analysis, Agatston calcium score.

stacks.name: medmcp-cohort
stacks.description: Clinical cohorts: read clinical tables, merge imaging biomarkers by subject and visit, select sub-cohorts with a CONSORT-style flow, Table 1, regression (incl. ordinal and mixed models) and survival, batch plans over many subjects.

stacks.name: medmcp-stats
stacks.description: Statistics and publication figures on any table: t-tests, ANOVA, rank tests, correlations, chi-square/Fisher with effect sizes and a draft results sentence; box, violin, scatter, Bland-Altman and other plots at journal size (PNG, SVG, PDF), restyled without re-running the analysis.
